issues: DJ Table: Track Library Browser: feature over 4 words: "Load To Deck A Button"
DJ Table: Track Library Browser: feature over 4 words: "Load To Deck B Button"

defs.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
defs.genInstructions: Build the left-hand playback deck with a large scrolling waveform, a central jog wheel, transport controls (play/pause, cue), a vertical pitch/tempo fader, hot-cue and loop pads, and a BPM/time readout. This deck plays and manipulates the track loaded into channel A.
defs.role: The left playback engine that plays and manipulates track A, feeding its signal to the mixer and receiving loads, EQ/volume, and effects from the other components.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
effectors.description: When the user clicks 'Load to Deck A' (or drags a track onto this deck) in the library, the selected track's audio, title/artist metadata, BPM, and waveform data are sent here; this deck resets to the track start, renders the new waveform, and updates the track info and BPM display.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
effectors.description: The mixer's Channel A fader, gain knob, and 3-band EQ knobs set this deck's output volume and per-band EQ in real time; the crossfader position further scales channel A's contribution. Values are applied continuously to this deck's audio output as the user moves the controls.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
effectors.description: When an FX unit is assigned to channel A and toggled on, the rack sends the selected effect type, dry/wet amount, beat-multiplier, and parameter values; this deck routes its playing audio through that effect chain and reflects it in the output.

targets.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
targets.description: This deck continuously emits its post-fader audio level and play/BPM state to the mixer so the Channel A VU meter and cue routing reflect the live signal; on play/pause the running state is pushed so the meter animates only while playing.

defs.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
defs.genInstructions: Build the right-hand playback deck mirroring Deck A: large scrolling waveform, central jog wheel, transport controls (play/pause, cue), vertical pitch/tempo fader, hot-cue and loop pads, and BPM/time readout. This deck plays and manipulates the track loaded into channel B.
defs.role: The right playback engine that plays and manipulates track B, feeding its signal to the mixer and receiving loads, EQ/volume, and effects from the other components.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
effectors.description: When the user clicks 'Load to Deck B' (or drags a track onto this deck) in the library, the selected track's audio, title/artist metadata, BPM, and waveform data are sent here; this deck resets to the track start, renders the new waveform, and updates the track info and BPM display.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
effectors.description: The mixer's Channel B fader, gain knob, and 3-band EQ knobs set this deck's output volume and per-band EQ in real time; the crossfader position further scales channel B's contribution. Values are applied continuously to this deck's audio output as the user moves the controls.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
effectors.description: When an FX unit is assigned to channel B and toggled on, the rack sends the selected effect type, dry/wet amount, beat-multiplier, and parameter values; this deck routes its playing audio through that effect chain and reflects it in the output.

targets.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
targets.description: This deck continuously emits its post-fader audio level and play/BPM state to the mixer so the Channel B VU meter and cue routing reflect the live signal; on play/pause the running state is pushed so the meter animates only while playing.

defs.name: DJ Table: Central Mixer
defs.genInstructions: Build the central mixer console sitting between the two decks: two channel volume faders, a horizontal crossfader, per-channel 3-band EQ knobs and gain, dual VU meters, cue/headphone buttons, and a master volume knob. This is the audio-blending hub of the table.
defs.role: The central blending hub that sets each deck's volume, gain, and EQ and crossfades between them, driven by the live signal meters the decks report back.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
effectors.description: Deck A streams its live post-fader audio level and play state to the mixer; the Channel A VU meter renders this level and animates only while Deck A is playing.

effectors.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
effectors.description: Deck B streams its live post-fader audio level and play state to the mixer; the Channel B VU meter renders this level and animates only while Deck B is playing.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: Moving the Channel A fader, gain knob, or 3-band EQ knobs sets Deck A's output volume and per-band EQ in real time; the crossfader position additionally scales channel A's level (full at the left end, silent at the right end). Changes are emitted continuously as the user drags.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: Moving the Channel B fader, gain knob, or 3-band EQ knobs sets Deck B's output volume and per-band EQ in real time; the crossfader position additionally scales channel B's level (full at the right end, silent at the left end). Changes are emitted continuously as the user drags.

defs.name: DJ Table: Effects Rack
defs.genInstructions: Build an effects rack panel with an effect-type selector (reverb, delay, filter, flanger, etc.), dry/wet knob, beat-multiplier control, parameter knobs, an on/off toggle, and a channel-assign switch to route the effect to Deck A or Deck B. Applies real-time FX to the chosen deck.
defs.role: The effects processor that applies real-time audio effects to whichever deck it is assigned to, augmenting the signal the decks play.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: When the channel-assign switch is set to A and the FX on/off is enabled, the rack sends the selected effect type, dry/wet amount, beat-multiplier, and parameter values; Deck A routes its playing audio through this effect chain and updates its output continuously as the knobs change.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: When the channel-assign switch is set to B and the FX on/off is enabled, the rack sends the selected effect type, dry/wet amount, beat-multiplier, and parameter values; Deck B routes its playing audio through this effect chain and updates its output continuously as the knobs change.

defs.name: DJ Table: Track Library Browser
defs.genInstructions: Build a track library browser with a search bar, a folder/crate tree, and a scrollable track list showing title, artist, BPM, and key, plus 'Load to Deck A' and 'Load to Deck B' buttons and a short preview player. This is where the DJ finds and loads music.
defs.role: The music source panel where the DJ searches, browses, and previews tracks and loads them onto either deck.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck A Player
targets.description: Clicking 'Load to Deck A' (or dragging a track onto Deck A) sends the highlighted track's audio, title/artist, BPM, and waveform data to Deck A, which loads it, renders the waveform, and resets to the start.

targets.name: DJ Table: Deck B Player
targets.description: Clicking 'Load to Deck B' (or dragging a track onto Deck B) sends the highlighted track's audio, title/artist, BPM, and waveform data to Deck B, which loads it, renders the waveform, and resets to the start.
